Uses of Package
org.tmt.aps.peas.computation.model

  • Packages that use org.tmt.aps.peas.computation.model 
    Package Description
    org.tmt.aps.peas.computation.business
    Computation library EJB and computation exception classes.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.computation.java
    Computations implemented in Java.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.computation.model
    Computation result data classes: each class name is unique to a computation so that automated data collection into ProcedureOutput subclasses can be performed without conflict.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.config.business
    Database updates/queries for constants, global configuration, procedure configuration; configuration data caches; real-time configuration of external interfaces.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.frame.business
    CCD Frame file and database reading/writing; Frame simulation; Frame marking utilities.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.executor
    Executors for procedures and subflows implemented as Singleton EJBs.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.model
    Procedure database related entities and the complete procedure output class hierarchy
    org.tmt.aps.peas.refBeamMap.model
    Database entity classes related to centroid maps and reference maps
    org.tmt.aps.peas.visualization.model
    Data Interfaces and Classes supporting visualization displays.
